source.method: Disassembly listings from ghidra-cli 12.1.4 and Capstone 5.0.7 were treated as leads. Every instruction sequence, table and string under staticChecks is confirmed against the pinned bytes by tools/verify_chara_presentation_consumers.py --exe, and the call, pattern and dword scans are recomputed from the image.

cases.payload: target dword 0, weight dword 1, bone name at +0x18

claims.claim: The object at chara +0x84 is the SceneModule with vtable 0x00F91DE8. Its slot 3, 0x004E8390, queues the ScenePacket that 0x004D7980 builds from a record number plus 0x15
The scene thread pump 0x004E9700 handles commands 3 to 6 itself and passes the others to 0x0060C140, which accepts commands 8 to 0x116 and tail-jumps to 0x007C93C0
0x007C93C0 sends commands 0x15 to 0x115 to virtual offset 0x274 of the actor found for the key, with the command minus 0x15, and sends commands 0x0E to 0x14 through a seven entry table

CharaActor slot 157 is 0x00662D30. It ignores every record while bit 6 of the actor dword at +0x2B70 is set and every record above 0x63, and it dispatches through a byte table and a 72 entry jump table
Records 0x0A, 0x0B, 0x0C, 0x0D and 0x0E reach the cases 0x006633CC, 0x0066340C, 0x00663497, 0x00663520 and 0x00663569
0x0058F130 initializes each look-at record to a flag word whose low five bits are 11010 (kind 5, bit 4 set, bit 0 clear) with bits 5 to 15 kept, priority 0, decay 0, target 0xC0000000 and weight 1.0
The arbiter reads bit 0 of the flag word as a sent marker, bits 1 to 3 as the message kind and bit 4 as a message flag, and it never reads bits 5 to 15
The native look-at routes 0x00589260, 0x005892B0, 0x00589310 and 0x00589380 write slot 0 of both banks at priority 0xC8 with decay 0 and skip a record whose priority is above the new one
The cancel worker stores priority 0 and kind 5, so the arbiter posts nothing for it, because a record without priority never wins and kind 5 selects no message
No call of the record writer 0x00585F60 passes a nonzero kind flag, so no traced writer produces kind 4
No traced writer produces kind 0, so the arbiter never posts record 0x0A

The named worker 0x00587FD0 is the only caller that gives the record writer a pointer, which the writer copies as 16 bytes to record +0x08, and it is reached from the server case for opcode 0x00DF and from 0x005892B0, which the callback of _lookAtCharacterEid calls through 0x0075C5B0
The cases for opcodes 0x00D3 and 0x00DB to 0x00DF sit on the full route of slot 9 that 0x004D8830 selects with a nonzero result, and the stricter route sends all six opcodes to the common exit
Opcode 0x00D3 writes the first payload dword as the target of slot 1 in both banks at priority 0x64 through 0x00587E70 and then stores it at chara +0x12C
Opcode 0x00DB writes slot 1 at priority 0x64 with the target from payload dword 0 and the weight from dword 1, and it ignores a target whose top three bits are 110
Opcode 0x00DC writes slot 1 at priority 0x64 as a position from payload dwords 0 to 2 with the weight from dword 3
Opcode 0x00DD writes slot 1 at priority 0x64 as kind 3 with two angle floats from payload dwords 0 and 1 and the weight from dword 2
Opcode 0x00DE calls the cancel worker for slot 1, and opcode 0x00DF writes slot 1 at priority 0x64 with a target, a weight and a 16 byte bone name
Slot 6 of CharaElement calls the arbiter 0x005861B0 once per call, after 0x00585D70 and 0x0058A090 and before the drain 0x0058DA10
For each bank the arbiter picks the record with the highest priority and the lowest slot on a tie, then lowers every nonzero priority by its decay byte down to 0
The arbiter posts nothing for a bank when no record has priority or when the winner has bit 0 set, and it leaves bit 0 of the three records unchanged in both cases
Kind 0 posts record 0x0A, kinds 1 and 4 post record 0x0B or, with a bone name, record 0x0C, kind 2 posts 0x0D, kind 3 posts 0x0E and kinds 5 to 7 post nothing

The payloads carry the bank in byte 0 and the weight and the target or vector, and byte 1 holds bit 0 set for kind 4 in record 0x0B, flag bit 4 in bit 0 and kind 4 in bit 1 in record 0x0C and flag bit 4 in bit 0 in records 0x0D and 0x0E, with the sizes 4, 12, 40, 20 and 16 for the records 0x0A, 0x0B, 0x0C, 0x0D and 0x0E
The payload priority byte of records 0x0B and 0x0C is the constant 0x64 for kind 1 and 0xC8 for kind 4 and does not come from the record
After a message or a kind 5 to 7 decision the winner gets bit 0 set and the other two records of the bank get it cleared
Slot 6 calls 0x00586150, which clears bit 0 of all six records, when bits 6 and 2 of byte +0x26D are set, and then clears bit 6
Bit 6 is set by the appearance post 0x00585D70 and bit 2 by element event 0x55, which CharaActor routine 0x0065FDA0 posts

CharaActor +0x2620 holds a controller with 2 groups of 3 slots of 0x40 bytes from +0x10, and records 0x0A to 0x0E write the slot whose index is the bank in group 0 or, for the group variant of records 0x0B and 0x0C, in group 1

The slot writers 0x00853B50, 0x00853C50 and 0x00853D30 store the weight at +0x18, a node name at +0x20, a vector at +0x30 and the setter flag 0x200, 0x80 or 0x100, and only 0x00853B50 stores a caller target at +0x1C
A weight equal to 0.0 sets bit 0 of slot byte +8, and the state machine answers it with one call of 0x0065BB50 with argument 1 and clears the bit
A slot written without a node name takes the name EID_LOOK_AT, and the target resolver asks the target actor for that node and falls back to the target position when the actor has no such node
EID_LOOK_AT names an attachment point of the target model, from the EID_ prefix and from the node matrix translation the resolver reads
0x00854600 steps each slot through the states 0 to 3 held in the low 3 flag bits and calls the constraint routines 0x00AC95D0, 0x00AC9980, 0x00ACA250 and 0x00AC99B0
The binder 0x008540A0 finds the constraints named k0, s0 and t0 for the three slot positions of each group and stores their indexes at slot +0
Record 0x0A resets a slot of group 0 to the target 0xC0000000 with weight 1.0
The record float travels as the slot weight to 0x00AC99B0 and 0x00ADD760, which store it in the weight field of the IK objects of type 2 and 3
The resolved target position travels to 0x00AC9980 and 0x00ADD6B0, which store it in the target field of the IK objects of type 2, 3 and 8
The IK object type code is 2 for LookAtIKObject, 3 for ConstraintDirectionIKObject and 8 for TwoJointIKObject, and LookAtIKObject slot 12 is 0x00AEAB00

LookAtIKObject slot 2, 0x00AED860, installs the step 0x00AED730, which runs the solve step 0x00AEA570 only while the float at +0xD4 is at least 0.00001 and otherwise clears the state at +0x60, +0xCC and +0xD0 and the active byte at +0x31

The record float is a blend weight of the IK objects, from the setter pair that writes it to one float of two member types and from the step gate that switches a LookAtIKObject off when the float is nearly 0
The solver 0x00AEAB00 of LookAtIKObject, its angle limits, rotation order and blend speed, was not traced
Record 0x33 from the turn back native reaches CharaActor case 0x00662FBC, which calls the turn back routine 0x007B0690 on the object at actor +0xBF0
0x007B0690 posts event 0x4A at once when no heading was saved or when the heading is within 0x38E39 units of the saved one, and otherwise starts a turn to the saved heading and clears the saved flag
The heading setter 0x00587D40 sets bit 1 of byte +0x26D and posts record 0x32, which CharaActor case 0x00662F94 hands to 0x0065C220 and the turn start 0x007B0530
0x007B0530 posts event 0x4A for a turn still pending, stores the target or saved heading, classifies the angle into six classes and starts the rotation and the timer
The angle classes are -1, -2, -3, 3, 2 and 1 for differences up to 0x1C71C7, 0x4E38E3, 0x800000, 0xB1C71C, 0xE38E39 and above in 24 bit units of 360 over 2 to the 24 degrees
The turn timer at controller +0x38 starts at 10.0 or at the float of the low 6 bits of the dword at controller +0x258 if that is larger, and mode 2 turns store 0 in +0x1C4
Each CharaActor slot 142 call lowers the timer by the delta times the controller scale at +0xF8, and when it reaches 0 the controller posts event 0x4A
The only calls of the event post 0x0065BEF0 are the timer expiry 0x007A4C20, the pending turn replacement 0x007B0547 and the turn back shortcut 0x007B06F6
0x007CE7B0 queues the event with its code plus 3 in the ring at container +0x17928, 0x004DAA10 subtracts 3 and calls element slot 8, and case 0x4A of 0x0058E0C0 clears bit 1 of byte +0x26D
Bit 1 of byte +0x26D is set at 0x00585EC0 and 0x00587DF2 and cleared by a pattern at 0x0058E373 only
The unit of the frame delta, the origin of the low 6 bits at controller +0x258 and the angle chase that follows 0x007A4CD0 were not traced
Commands 0x10 and 0x11 reach 0x007CCCC0 with 1 and 0 through the command table entries 0x007C9696 and 0x007C96B4
0x007CCCC0 sets bit 1 of the actor byte at +0xE8 when the argument is 0 and clears it otherwise, and CharaActor slot 43 reports visible when that byte is 0

When the visibility answer changes, 0x007CCCC0 calls 0x00A5FA10, which forwards to the object at actor +0x0C, and virtual offset 0x250 of the actor, which is the empty routine 0x00712B40 for CharaActor
Command 0x3B is record 0x26, whose CharaActor case 0x00663074 calls 0x0065CC60 with the float at payload +4 and 0x007A42B0 stores it as the target at +0x588 of the object at actor +0x590

0x007A7280 adds to the current value at +0x58C the smaller of 0.02 and the difference between target and current times 0.02 times the delta in state 0, so an upward step is capped at 0.02 and a downward step is not
The placement routine 0x00660F70 adds the current value, read by 0x007A42F0, to the probed ground height when the probe reports a hit and its gates pass
The probed value is the actor height, from the addition into the second position component and the native name
The marker number is the low 6 bits of the dword at chara +0x270, read by 0x00585300 at 0x006808BC in 0x00680810 and at 0x006A2EA9 in 0x006A2E90

0x00680810 uses 0 for the chara stored at +0x9E0 of its context and -1 for another chara when bit 2 of byte +0x26D is clear or the number is 0 or above 0x40, passes -1 to the untraced 0x00680730, and clears the entity only for 0x3F
Bits 6 to 10 of the same dword are read by 0x00585310 at 0x006809E9 and only 0x00680810 calls it
The two marker strings are the 0x20 byte buffers at +0x34 of the two 0x54 byte records at chara +0x3B0 and +0x404, and 0x005881C0 clears them with the record flags
No instruction reads the string buffers at chara +0x3E4 or +0x438 by displacement, and the readers behind the record base were not traced

NpcBase slot 12, 0x006F8660, calls the base routine 0x006E18B0 and, when it returns the byte at +0x5C as nonzero, calls 0x0076D920 with the pending number and vector and then releases the pending object at +0x128
Slot 12 of CharaBase, PlayerBase and MyPlayer is 0x006E18B0 and slot 12 of NpcBase is 0x006F8660
Chara +0x12C starts at 0xC0000000 and the case for opcode 0x00D3 stores payload dword 0 in it
NpcBase +0x154 is set to 0 by the NpcBase constructor
No function in the NpcBase vtable stores to +0x154
